description:
Becario/a de Marketing Digital y Creación de Contenido

Empresa: MOLDESA ENVASES

Ubicación: Zapopan, Jalisco

Modalidad: Híbrida (presencial y remota)

Tipo de puesto: Medio tiempo o tiempo completo, con horario flexible




Descripción de la empresa

MOLDESA ENVASES es una empresa dedicada al diseño, fabricación y comercialización de envases plásticos para diferentes industrias, como alimentos, bebidas, cosmética, limpieza y más.

Buscamos fortalecer nuestra presencia digital, conectar con nuevos clientes y desarrollar estrategias de contenido que comuniquen el valor de nuestros productos. Por ello, queremos integrar a nuestro equipo a una persona con creatividad, iniciativa y ganas de aprender, que desee adquirir experiencia práctica en marketing digital y creación de contenido.




Descripción de la vacante

Buscamos un/a estudiante, recién egresado/a o persona interesada en desarrollarse profesionalmente en el área de marketing digital, con facilidad para comunicarse frente a la cámara, crear contenido audiovisual e investigar tendencias de mercado.

La persona seleccionada participará en la planeación de contenido, grabación y edición de videos, gestión de redes sociales e investigación de nuevas oportunidades para posicionar nuestra marca.

No es necesario dominar todos los procesos desde el inicio. Valoramos especialmente la iniciativa, la creatividad, la capacidad de aprender y el interés por comprender cómo funciona el mercado para transformar ideas en contenido atractivo y útil para nuestros clientes.

Queremos que esta persona se involucre en los proyectos, proponga ideas y desarrolle habilidades que le permitan crecer profesionalmente mientras contribuye al crecimiento de la empresa.




Responsabilidades principales

Planeación de contenido: apoyar en la elaboración de calendarios de publicaciones y organización de ideas para redes sociales.
Creación de videos: participar frente a la cámara para presentar productos, explicar sus características y comunicar ideas de manera natural.
Grabación y edición: producir videos cortos y contenido visual para Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn y otras plataformas.
Investigación de mercado: estudiar tendencias, competidores, clientes potenciales y referencias de contenido para identificar nuevas oportunidades.
Conocimiento de productos: aprender sobre nuestros envases, sus aplicaciones, características y procesos de fabricación para desarrollar contenido auténtico.
Gestión de redes sociales: apoyar en la preparación, publicación y seguimiento de contenido digital.
Propuestas creativas: desarrollar ideas para campañas, videos y estrategias que ayuden a mejorar el posicionamiento de la marca.
Seguimiento de resultados: revisar métricas básicas de alcance, reproducciones e interacción para identificar oportunidades de mejora.
Apoyo comercial: crear contenido que ayude a presentar nuestros productos, atraer clientes potenciales y generar oportunidades de venta.

Requisitos

Ser estudiante, recién egresado/a o contar con interés en desarrollarse en marketing, comunicación, publicidad, producción audiovisual o áreas relacionadas.
Tener facilidad para hablar frente a la cámara o disposición para desarrollar esta habilidad.
Contar con conocimientos básicos de grabación y edición de video. Se valorará el manejo de CapCut, Premiere Pro o herramientas similares.
Tener interés por investigar tendencias, analizar el mercado y comprender al público objetivo.
Ser una persona creativa, organizada, responsable y con iniciativa.
Tener disposición para aprender sobre productos, procesos de fabricación y estrategias comerciales.
Manejar redes sociales y conocer sus principales formatos de contenido.
Se valorará contar con un portafolio de videos, publicaciones o proyectos personales, escolares o profesionales.
Saber ingles y hablar fluidamente 

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Horario flexible: buscamos acordar un horario que se adapte tanto a las necesidades de la empresa como a la disponibilidad de la persona seleccionada.
Dos opciones de jornada: posibilidad de colaborar medio tiempo o tiempo completo, según el perfil y los acuerdos establecidos.
Modalidad híbrida: combinación de trabajo presencial en nuestras instalaciones de Zapopan y actividades remotas, de acuerdo con las tareas y la planeación.
Experiencia práctica: participación en proyectos reales de marketing, creación de contenido y desarrollo de estrategias digitales.
Aprendizaje profesional: oportunidad de conocer el funcionamiento de una empresa, sus productos, sus clientes y sus procesos comerciales.
Libertad para proponer ideas: buscamos escuchar propuestas creativas y dar espacio para desarrollar nuevas iniciativas.
Desarrollo de habilidades: experiencia en investigación de mercado, producción audiovisual, comunicación digital y marketing orientado a resultados.

Las condiciones de horario, presencialidad y apoyo económico se acordarán de manera clara durante el proceso de selección.




¿Qué tipo de persona buscamos?

Buscamos a alguien con curiosidad, iniciativa y ganas de crecer. Una persona que disfrute crear contenido, investigar cómo se comunica el mercado y encontrar formas creativas de presentar productos.

Nos interesa especialmente alguien que no se limite a ejecutar instrucciones, sino que tenga iniciativa para investigar, proponer, organizar sus ideas y aprender de los resultados.

La facilidad para hablar frente a la cámara es importante, pero también valoramos la disposición para mejorar, la responsabilidad y el interés por comprender las necesidades de los clientes.




Modalidad y horario de trabajo

El puesto se desarrollará bajo una modalidad híbrida, combinando actividades presenciales en nuestras instalaciones de Zapopan con trabajo remoto cuando las tareas lo permitan.

La frecuencia de asistencia presencial y el horario se definirán de común acuerdo, considerando las necesidades de grabación, el conocimiento de los productos, las actividades del equipo y la disponibilidad de la persona seleccionada.

Podrá proponerse una jornada de medio tiempo o de tiempo completo, buscando una organización que permita cumplir con los objetivos del puesto y mantener un equilibrio con las actividades académicas, cuando corresponda.




Objetivo del puesto

Contribuir al desarrollo de una estrategia de contenido digital constante y bien organizada que fortalezca la presencia de MOLDESA ENVASES, comunique el valor de nuestros productos y ayude a atraer nuevos clientes y oportunidades comerciales, mientras la persona seleccionada adquiere experiencia práctica y desarrolla sus habilidades profesionales.

description:
About Lendable
Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:


One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people
Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK
Profitable since 2017
Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs
Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)


So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1
Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions
Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting


Growth Lead

We’re looking for a senior Growth Lead with deep expertise in brand and trade marketing to shape how Mexican consumers see our brand and to build our in-store acquisition channel. Your mission is not just to grow volume, but to grow the right customers: attracting higher-quality, lower-risk and more profitable cardholders for our Mexico Credit Card.

A big part of the opportunity is a channel few card issuers in Mexico are present in: in-store acquisition through our merchant partners. Physical retailers already distribute our cards at the point of sale, and the channel is largely untapped. We want someone who can turn it into a growth engine through trade marketing, in-store promotions, POP and co-marketing with our merchants.

You’ll also own our brand in Mexico: positioning, messaging and creative direction across socials, digital and in-store. You’ll work closely with our UK growth and analytics team, who lead performance marketing, tracking and attribution, and with our Credit team to make sure every campaign brings in customers who are good for the business.

This role is central to scaling our Mexico Credit Card, a mobile-app–first product designed for credit builders in Mexico.

What You’ll Do

 Build Trade & Retail Marketing at the Point of Sale
Own the growth strategy for our in-store acquisition channel with physical merchant partners.
Build and run a trade marketing calendar with each merchant: promotions such as a free card with the purchase of selected products or above a spend threshold, in-store activations and brand ambassadors.
Develop POP and in-store advertising, from concept to production and rollout across store networks, that drives awareness and sign-ups at the shelf and at checkout.
Launch co-marketing campaigns with merchants through their own channels (apps, loyalty programs, catalogues, socials) and joint offers.
Work with merchant partners, Operations and Engineering on execution: store staff incentives and training, systems integration and reconciliation of promotion costs.
Build a repeatable playbook so we can launch new merchant partners quickly.
 Own & Build Our Brand in Mexico
Own brand positioning, messaging and identity, shaping how Mexican consumers perceive us so we attract the customers we want to serve.
Define creative direction and lead brand campaigns across socials, digital, out-of-home and in-store.
Build a creative engine (in-house, agencies, creators) that produces high-quality assets at speed.
Grow our organic social presence, content and community.
Track brand health (awareness, consideration, perception) and connect brand work to acquisition results.
 Connect Brand, Retail & Digital
Design digital-to-store campaigns with merchants that drive customers into stores to get their card (e.g. geo-targeted social, merchant channels).
Keep the brand consistent across every touchpoint, and provide messaging and creative for our performance campaigns.
Partner with the UK growth and analytics team, who own performance marketing execution, tracking and attribution, so brand and trade campaigns are properly measured and learnings flow both ways.
 Measure What Matters
Own the brand and trade marketing budget, and the return on it.
Define clear KPIs for every campaign and merchant: cost per account, approval and activation rates, and customer quality.
Work with Credit and the UK analytics team to understand which campaigns, merchants and promotions bring in profitable customers, and how CAC compares to LTV.
Use results to reallocate spend across merchants, promotions and campaigns.


Required Experience
What We’re Looking For

6+ years in brand, trade, retail or shopper marketing, with senior ownership of meaningful budgets and targets, ideally at consumer brands, retailers or financial services in Mexico.
A proven track record of launching trade marketing and in-store campaigns with retailers: promotions, POP, activations and co-marketing.
Experience building or repositioning a consumer brand: positioning, messaging, creative direction and campaigns.
Strong experience working with and negotiating with Mexican retailers and their store teams.
Experience managing creative, BTL and production agencies and vendors.
Commercially minded and data-literate: comfortable setting KPIs, reading campaign results and tying spend to outcomes.
Strong execution across many stakeholders (merchants, Operations, Finance, Credit).
Proficiency in English and Spanish (you’ll work closely with our UK team).
Deep understanding of Mexican consumers.


Nice to Have


Experience in performance marketing across Meta, Google, TikTok or app marketing.
Familiarity with tracking and data integrations, such as Meta Conversions API (CAPI), Google offline conversions, MMPs and attribution.
Analytical skills such as SQL, cohort analysis or unit economics (CAC, LTV, payback).
Experience in credit cards, lending or other financial services, ideally with an understanding of credit risk.
Previous start-up or scale-up experience, ideally building a channel from zero.
Experience leading a team.


The Type of Work You’ll Be Doing

Plan and launch trade marketing promotions with merchant partners.
Create POP and in-store materials, and roll them out across store networks.
Negotiate co-marketing plans with merchants and onboard new partners.
Define our brand positioning and lead brand campaigns.
Brief and manage creative work, agencies and creators.
Design digital-to-store campaigns with merchants.
Review campaign and merchant performance with Credit and the UK analytics team, and reallocate budget.
Report on growth performance to leadership and keep the team focused on what moves the needle.
Help hire and build out the growth team as we scale.

Ownership: You own brand and in-store acquisition end to end, from strategy and budget to results.

description:
Job Title: Growth Marketing / Performance Marketing Director | Remote




Location: Latin America, South Africa

Salary: $6,500-$8,000/month gross

Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week (Flexible - Should be available for the majority of U.S. Pacific and Central Time business hours).




Only English CVs will be accepted.




Retalent Agency is a global remote recruitment agency that connects talented professionals like you with top companies in e-commerce, marketing, and tech. Since 2019, we’ve helped hundreds of candidates from Latin America, Eastern Europe, Asia, and South Africa land full-time remote roles with international teams.

When you apply through Retalent, you’re not just applying for a job; you’re stepping into a community of growing businesses and ambitious professionals.

Let us help you find the right opportunity to grow your career from anywhere in the world.




Our Client:




This company was founded by physicians who saw a hard truth: medical bills were pushing working families into financial hardship, even when they had insurance. So they set out to rebuild healthcare from the ground up.




What began as a better way to deliver affordable care is now a nationwide model. Today, they serve small businesses, individuals, and families in all 50 states. Along the way, they’ve saved their members hundreds of millions of dollars on medical bills.

They believe quality healthcare shouldn’t be only for people with large-employer benefits. The industry is full of waste, paperwork, and surprise costs. These leave people confused, frustrated, and overcharged. This company set out to fix that.




Their care team supports members 24/7, in English and Spanish. They help members understand what care they need, where to get it, and how to pay the least for it. They put people first always.




In This Role, You’ll:




Own the full growth engine of a mission-driven healthcare company, shaping how it reaches individuals, families, small businesses, and brokers. Startup or small-team experience where you worked hands-on.

Basic graphic design skills (e.g., Canva, Figma).

description:
You're writing copy for brands you don't care about. The work is fine. The numbers are good. And none of it matters to you anymore.




Another SaaS launch. Another "exciting new feature." Another founder who thinks "synergy" belongs in a subject line. You've sat on feedback calls where someone said "it's not catchy enough" and couldn't tell you what catchy meant. You've delivered 20 subject line alternatives because the first 19 were "good first effort!" One client texted you on a holiday. One called at midnight. One cancelled the project after the copy was written and acted like you should be grateful for the experience.




And somewhere in the middle of all that, something worse happened. Quieter than a bad client. You started losing your own voice. Writing for so many brands that thrive on inauthenticity that your instincts flattened. The part of you that cared whether the copy was brilliant or just adequate went quiet. Nobody was asking for brilliant. They were asking for adequate on a deadline.




But that's not who you are.




You're the person who's up at 6:47 am on a Saturday rewriting a subject line that's been bothering you since Thursday. Not for a deadline. Not for a client. Because it's not right yet and that's enough of a reason.




You sit in a restaurant, look at the menu, and think "who signed off on this?" You screenshot landing pages that work. You reverse-engineer email sequences from brands you'll never work for, just to understand what they did.




You know the rush of nailing a subject line before the data confirms it. You take it personally when one underperforms. Not in a dramatic way. In a "this could be better and I already know how" way.




The question that keeps surfacing isn't just "is there a place where the writing matters?"




Is there a place where I get to care again?




Keep reading.




- - -




This is the person on the other end of your email.




Picture the woman who opens your email on a Tuesday morning. Her name is Margaret. She's 68. She lives alone. Her knees hurt, her back hurts, her hands hurt. She's spent thousands on programs that didn't work. She's been told "that's just age" by doctors who shrugged. She's starting to wonder if this is just how it ends.




She opens your email. Not because of a subject line trick. Because she trusts the voice. Because the last email felt like someone actually understood what it's like to be her.




That voice is you. That's the job.




- - -




Here's where you'd do it.




The Fitness Doctor exists because most fitness programs don't work for people over 50. Not because the science isn't there. Because nobody translates it into something a 68-year-old widow with chronic knee pain actually trusts enough to try. Research-backed movement science. The kind where people actually get their lives back. Most of the people you'd write for are women. Sixties and seventies. Post-menopausal. Many are widows. Many are dealing with the quiet terror of losing the independence they worked 35 years to earn.




The team doesn't just market to these people. They do the physical training themselves. That's not a line in a culture deck. It's Tuesday morning at 7 am.




The work is remote and asynchronous. What matters is what you produce, not when you're online.




You'd write in one voice. Not yours. The founder's. His name is Robbie, and he talks to his audience like they're friends sitting in his living room. Your job is to disappear completely. If you can't do that, if you need your voice in everything you write, this isn't the role.




You'd write emails, sales letters, campaign copy. You'd architect launches from pre-launch to post-launch.




You'd work inside ActiveCampaign. Load emails into templates, apply tags, understand segments and contact flows.




You'd look at open rates, click rates, and conversion data and adjust copy accordingly. The data isn't decoration. It's direction.




As you grow, you'd build automations and workflows in the CRM. Design segmentation strategy. Not just "what tag goes where" but "why this segment gets this message at this moment." Build quiz funnels. Write affiliate swipes. Write hook-first ad copy for social platforms.




This role needs fluent English. Not "good English." Fluent. Nuance matters when your reader is a 68-year-old woman in chronic pain who has been let down by every program she's tried.




It needs self-discipline. Nobody here micromanages your calendar. You see what needs writing and you write it. You see what's broken and you flag it.




And it needs coachability. You'll get direct feedback on copy. Sometimes line-by-line. If your first instinct is to defend every word instead of pressure-testing whether the note makes the piece stronger, you'll hit a wall fast.




This isn't a "stay in your lane" role. It's an "everything you've ever learned finally matters" role.




- - -




Now let me save us both some time.




I'm Jon. I run the marketing side. And I'd rather be straight with you now than waste three weeks finding out we're not a fit.




There's the copywriter who needs a three-page brief before they can write three paragraphs. We have frameworks, templates, a voice guide, and a review process. What we don't have is the bandwidth to hand-hold every send. If you need to be told what to write, you'll suffocate here. If you see what needs to be written and write it, you'll thrive.




There's the copywriter who writes "salesy" copy. Countdown timers. "ONLY 3 SPOTS LEFT." Scarcity manipulation. Fear-based CTAs. The numbers often look great in the short term. But our audience is a 68-year-old woman who has been manipulated by every program she's tried. She can smell it. And when she does, we lose her forever. Not just the sale. Her trust. If manipulation is your toolkit, this is not your brand.




There's the copywriter who can't write in someone else's voice. They've got a style. It's strong. It wins awards. It sounds like them. And it sounds nothing like Robbie. This is a place where your voice disappears into a brand and the brand gets stronger because of it. If that sounds suffocating, this isn't for you. If it sounds like a craft challenge you'd enjoy, keep reading.




There's the copywriter who disappears between deadlines. Delivers on time, good work, but between sends they're a ghost. No check-ins, no ideas, no presence. We're a small team. Campaigns overlap. Priorities shift. If you show up only when it's time to deliver, you're missing the part where the real thinking happens.




And there's the copywriter who only wants to write. "Don't ask me to tag a contact. Don't ask me to look at a dashboard. Don't ask me to think about what happens after they click." If the word "automation" makes your eyes glaze over, we're not compatible. The best emails in the world are worthless if the funnel behind them is broken.




If any of that is you, we wish you well. No hard feelings.




- - -




Here's what you get.




A home.




Not a gig. Not another agency that assigns you a brand on Monday and moves you to a different one by Friday. Not the feast-and-famine cycle where a great month is followed by silence.




A single brand you can invest in. One audience you can study and serve better every quarter. The kind of relationship with a brand where you stop writing AT people and start writing FOR someone. Where you know Margaret's fears and hopes well enough that the copy writes itself some mornings.




A team that values what you bring beyond the copy. Every skill you've accumulated that's been wasted because you were "just the writer" somewhere else. It matters here. Write emails today, architect a launch next week, shape a quiz funnel the week after. The variety isn't a perk. It's the job.




You have an operational brain. The one that sees the email, the sequence, the tag, the segment, and the human on the other end. All at once. That brain has a place here.




Real growth. Not a title bump. The company is expanding into new programs, new audiences, new channels. You're not joining something that's coasting. You're joining something that's building. The writer who starts with email campaigns is the same writer who's shaping launch strategy and segmentation architecture six months from now.




A team that operates with love, care, and connection for the people they serve. You'll feel it in how campaigns are discussed. You'll feel it in the fact that nobody here treats Margaret like a conversion metric.




And the thing you probably want most but won't say out loud. A place where you get to care again. Where the craft matters. Where doing brilliant work instead of adequate work is the expectation, not the exception.




That's what's on the table.




- - -

Compensation & Growth Path - MXN

A structured 4-month paid onboarding and training process:

Month 1: $10,000 MXN
Month 2: $15,000 MXN
Month 3: $20,000 MXN
Month 4: $25,000 MXN




After onboarding, you’ll be positioned to earn $25,000+ MXN per month. After your first year with us, you’ll also receive:

2 weeks of paid vacation
Health insurance
Retirement fund contributions 




Here's how to reach us.




You're here now, you read this, and you already know this role was created for you.




Hit the apply button and send us:




Resume
Two or three samples of copy you've written in someone else's voice. Emails preferred. We want to see you write as a client, not as yourself.
Pick one of those samples and tell us: What was the brief? What did you write? What happened after it went live?
Why did this post feel like it was written for you? A few sentences. Not a cover letter.




No resume required upfront. We care about what you can do, not where you've been.




Come show us.

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 

About the role:

Have you built something with AI that changed how your team works? Maybe it's an agentic workflow that runs a process from start to finish, or an automation that fixed an operational problem nobody else could solve. We're looking for a senior builder who already works this way and is ready to do it at scale. You'll own projects in our AI-native knowledge framework. You'll work with subject matter experts and peers to create customer documentation and to design the systems that produce it. Experience in technical writing or content development helps, but your track record of building with AI matters most.



You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best. 

Learn more about what we value at Samsara.

In this role, you will:

Design and build AI-powered workflows that change how we create, review, and maintain knowledge content. Examples include agentic pipelines that draft articles from product release information, or automations that flag outdated content.
Find operational problems across the knowledge program and solve them with AI, from intake and routing to quality checks and SME review.
Own projects on the content operations roadmap from scoping through delivery, including timelines, dependencies, and stakeholder updates.
Set and improve the processes and standards the team uses to develop knowledge, and make sure they work well with our AI tools.
Track KPIs on how well our knowledge content performs, share what you learn, and use the data to decide what to build or fix next.
Work with subject matter experts and peers to create and maintain accurate customer documentation.

Minimum requirements for this role:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
6+ years of professional experience in operations, program management, knowledge management, technical writing, content development, learning and development, or a related field
Hands-on experience building AI solutions to operational problems, such as agentic workflows, multi-step automations, or AI tools connected to other systems. You can walk us through what you built, why you built it, and what changed as a result
Experience owning projects from start to finish, including scoping, timelines, dependencies, and coordination across teams
Experience creating or maintaining technical content, such as documentation, training materials, or knowledge base articles
A track record of spotting problems and solving them without detailed direction
Clear communication with cross-functional partners and stakeholders at every level

An ideal candidate also has:

Experience connecting AI tools to other systems through APIs, automation platforms, or MCP servers
Experience structuring content so AI systems can retrieve and use it accurately
Proficiency in Jira and experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
Experience with Confluence and Zendesk, or similar knowledge and support platforms
Experience querying data and building dashboards, ideally in Databricks or with SQL
A background in knowledge management or technical writing
 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Digital Commerce & Marketing Director
description:
Description

The Purpose Pilot is a healthcare marketing agency that helps practices get found, trusted and chosen online. Since 2019 we have built branding, websites, SEO and GEO, social content and strategy.




We built Altitude™, an AI-powered multichannel dashboard that helps clients track and improve their digital presence. Our specialists review every change it recommends.




Compliance and trust are built into how we work: HIPAA-aware forms, and content reviewed against HIPAA, FTC, LegitScript and ad platform rules.




The Role




We are hiring a remote, contract Account Manager based in Mexico to own day-to-day relationships with our healthcare clients across both Altitude and our agency services. You will be the person clients trust to explain what is happening with their search visibility, websites and campaigns, and the person our internal team trusts to turn client goals into clear, prioritized work.




This role is as much about relationships as it is about knowledge. Our clients ask hard questions about rankings, AI citations, page speed, schema and ad spend, and you need to answer them with confidence. You will work closely with our strategists, designers, our developer and the Altitude platform itself, translating between technical detail and plain-English outcomes for practice owners and marketing directors.

Client relationships

Track Google Business Profile health and local pack performance for practices that depend on local patients.

Working SEO knowledge: you can read a site audit, explain technical, on-page and local SEO issues to a client, and find your way around Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4.
A working understanding of GEO (generative engine optimization): how ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google AI Mode choose which sources to cite, and what improves those odds.
Comfort with web projects. You don't need to code, but you understand how websites are built, can talk with developers about CMS platforms, and can check a page before launch.
Clear, warm communication.

Comfort working alongside AI tools and judging when an AI recommendation is right and when it needs a human fix.




If you're strong with clients and curious about the technical side, we'll help you learn the rest. Altitude and our specialists handle the deep technical work.

description:
About Owner

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.

Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.

Our vision

We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.

Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.

In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.

Our traction

Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website.

More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.

Our team

Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.

We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.

Where we work

Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!

Why we're looking for you

Owner.com is growing quickly, and we are looking for a proactive and results-driven Associate Customer Success Manager to join our team. In this role, you will manage a large, dynamic portfolio of 120+ customers across all stages of the customer lifecycle. Your primary focus will be on engaging with our most at-risk customer segment to maximize product adoption, deliver customer value, and mitigate churn risks. Through your efforts, you will aim to generate brand ambassadors and uncover expansion opportunities to drive growth.

As a key player in the customer experience, you will have the opportunity to influence changes on your direct team and the customer journey by providing valuable feedback to cross-functional teams to shape the future of our product and offerings.

Success in this role will be measured by key performance metrics, including revenue retention and customer engagement.

This is a remote-first role, open to candidates based in Mexico.

description:
About Owner

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.

Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.

Our vision

We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.

Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.

In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.

Our traction

Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website.

More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.

Our team

Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.

We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.

Where we work

Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!

Why We’re Looking for You

Owner.com is growing quickly, and we’re hiring a Quality Assurance Specialist to join our Customer Success team. You’ll evaluate the calls our CSMs lead, both proactive outreach and reactive retention calls, and make sure we’re hitting a high standard of service based on our Customer Success Quality rubrics. Beyond scoring calls, you’ll spot recurring gaps in communication or process, surface coaching opportunities, and work closely with Success leadership to recommend training and process improvements.

You’ll do well here if you like a fast pace, solve problems creatively, and are strong at both managing your time and reading data.

The Impact You’ll Have


Listen to and score Customer Success calls focused on customer retention, across both proactive and reactive motions
Share clear trends and coaching opportunities with Success leadership based on rubric scores
Guide enablement and training for the CSM team based on what you’re hearing on calls

About Owner

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.

Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.

Our vision

We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.

Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.

In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.

Our traction

Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website.

More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

 

 

𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗬𝗼𝘂'𝗹𝗹 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲 𝗮𝗻 𝗜𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗰𝘁:

As a Customer Recovery Coach, you will model our AI Smarts + Hospitality Hearts—the mission for Cloudbeds Customer Success—sitting at the vital intersection of customer retention and product success. You will drive the shift from a reactive support function to an Intelligent Recovery Motion, leveraging early risk detection and firsthand hotel operations experience to turn frustration into loyalty. This role centers on orchestrating the Fire-Team concept—a cross-functional, executive-level intervention designed to deliver decisive issue resolution for our most critical accounts. You will be a Caring Rebel leader who understands that technology should handle the administrative drag, while humans handle the relationship magic. You will leverage AI-driven insights to proactively identify risk and design recovery processes that prove Cloudbeds is central to our customers' business success.

 

𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝗖𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗺𝗲𝗿 𝗦𝘂𝗰𝗰𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗧𝗲𝗮𝗺:

Our Customer Success team is where Hospitality Hearts meet Smart Solutions. We are a fully-remote group of former hoteliers and customer experience professionals, focused on removing unnecessary manual work so we can focus on our human magic: building and strengthening relationships with our customers, and ensuring Cloudbeds remains central to their business success and guest service excellence. If you are driven by emotional intelligence, trust building, and delivering deeply personalized hospitality moments instead of repetitive operational work, you will feel right at home here.

 

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗕𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗼 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗧𝗲𝗮𝗺:

Own the customer recovery motion, triaging high-impact queues of at-risk customers with a goal of proactive rescue and structured save motions.
Champion the core principle: Standardize the repeatable, personalize the meaningful. Use AI and automation tooling to handle administrative tasks, freeing capacity for deep-dive recovery work.
Drive momentum to value by acting as an internal consultant, coordinating across Sales, Onboarding, and Product to remove technical or operational blockers.
Own clear, customer-friendly communication, delivering concise and highly personalized updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
Maintain clean systems and actionable data, logging activities in Salesforce and capturing "voice of the customer" signals to feed back to leadership.
Identify patterns of friction and propose systemic process improvements to stop issues before they start, ruthlessly eliminating hero-dependency.
Orchestrate the Fire-Team motion: Serve as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for at-risk accounts, mobilizing internal stakeholders across Support, Product, and Engineering to restore trust and ensure the customer never has to ask "Who owns this?"

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 

About the role:

As a Samsara Technical Account Manager (TAM), you are the cornerstone of technical customer success. In this role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor, moving beyond traditional support to deliver measurable business value and drive the long-term adoption of the Samsara platform. Your mission is to proactively optimize your customers' technical health and mitigate risk, ensuring they achieve their desired outcomes.

This requires a unique blend of deep technical acumen, consultative problem-solving, and the ability to communicate with influence across both technical and executive stakeholders. You will build enduring customer relationships by translating their operational goals into powerful technical solutions. As the primary technical interface for your accounts, you will foster cross-functional collaboration with our Sales, Support, and Product teams to champion your customers' needs. During critical incidents, you will demonstrate ownership by managing customer communications and expectations through to a successful resolution.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in Mexico.

You should apply if:


You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.



In this role, you will: 

Drive Customer Impact & Value Realization: Go beyond technical support to consistently deliver measurable value. You will develop a deep understanding of your customers' business objectives and proactively align Samsara's solutions to help them achieve their goals, tracking and demonstrating technical ROI along the way.
Use AI to Transform the Customer Experience: Leverage AI-powered tools and insights to anticipate customer needs, personalize engagement, and deliver faster, more proactive, and impactful outcomes.
Execute Transformational Technical Account Management: Independently manage a portfolio of accounts, developing tailored success plans and identifying and mitigating risks to customer health. You will maintain accurate records of customer interactions and contribute to team-wide objectives.
Demonstrate Deep Technical Acumen & Samsara Expertise: Be the primary technical point of contact, mastering Samsara's platform, including APIs, hardware, and software. You will advise customers on best practices and troubleshoot complex technical issues with proficiency.
Provide Consultative Problem Solving & Solutioning: Employ a consultative approach to understand the root cause of customer challenges. You will own the technical ticket lifecycle, including technical escalations from report to resolution, and conduct root cause analysis to prevent recurrence and drive product improvement.
Communicate with Influence and Clarity: Lead customer meetings, from technical deep dives to quarterly technical account reviews, with confidence. You will adapt your communication style to effectively engage with diverse audiences, from technical staff to non-technical executives.
Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and deliver a unified experience.
Demonstrate Ownership and Act as a Multiplier: Embody a 'get it done' mentality by taking initiative on team projects and process improvements. You will actively contribute to our internal knowledge base and help onboard new team members, sharing best practices to enhance the entire team's capabilities.
Embody Samsara's Values & Principles: Consistently champion and role model Samsara's core values and operating principles in every interaction, actively seeking feedback for continuous improvement



Minimum requirements for the role:

Experience: 7+ years experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, solutions consulting, or customer success, with a demonstrated track record of success. 
Education: We welcome applications from candidates with a bachelor's degree in a technical field, or those who have gained equivalent expertise through practical experience in areas such as Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields.
Technical Proficiency: Exceptional technical literacy with the ability to understand and troubleshoot complex hardware, software, and API integrations. A strong passion for technology and a commitment to continuous learning, including an interest in AI and its applications.
Bilingual: English and Spanish is a must.
Customer Focus: A data-informed approach to understanding customer needs and a demonstrated ability to build trusted, long-term relationships.
Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish is required. 
Collaborative Spirit: A team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment and works effectively with internal teams to drive customer success.



An ideal candidate also has:

Experience supporting global enterprise-level customers in a SaaS, IoT, or PaaS environment.
Proven experience leveraging AI tools and methodologies in daily workflows to drive efficiency, generate customer insights, and improve overall customer success.
Prior experience with Samsara, Salesforce, Zendesk, Jira, Gong, Gainsight, and Tableau.
Basic Python coding skills are an asset for providing enhanced technical solutions
 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Use AI to Transform the Customer Experience: Leverage AI-powered tools and insights to anticipate customer needs, personalize engagement, and deliver faster, more proactive, and impactful outcomes.
Execute Transformational Technical Account Management: Independently manage a portfolio of accounts, developing tailored success plans and identifying and mitigating risks to customer health. You will maintain accurate records of customer interactions and contribute to team-wide objectives.
Demonstrate Deep Technical Acumen & Samsara Expertise: Be the primary technical point of contact, mastering Samsara's platform, including APIs, hardware, and software. You will advise customers on best practices and troubleshoot complex technical issues with proficiency.
Provide Consultative Problem Solving & Solutioning: Employ a consultative approach to understand the root cause of customer challenges. You will own the technical ticket lifecycle, including technical escalations from report to resolution, and conduct root cause analysis to prevent recurrence and drive product improvement.
Communicate with Influence and Clarity: Lead customer meetings, from technical deep dives to quarterly technical account reviews, with confidence. You will adapt your communication style to effectively engage with diverse audiences, from technical staff to non-technical executives.
Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and deliver a unified experience.
Demonstrate Ownership and Act as a Multiplier: Embody a 'get it done' mentality by taking initiative on team projects and process improvements. You will actively contribute to our internal knowledge base and help onboard new team members, sharing best practices to enhance the entire team's capabilities.
Embody Samsara's Values & Principles: Consistently champion and role model Samsara's core values and operating principles in every interaction, actively seeking feedback for continuous improvement



Minimum requirements for the role:

Experience: 7+ years experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, solutions consulting, or customer success, with a demonstrated track record of success. 
Education: We welcome applications from candidates with a bachelor's degree in a technical field, or those who have gained equivalent expertise through practical experience in areas such as Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields.
Technical Proficiency: Exceptional technical literacy with the ability to understand and troubleshoot complex hardware, software, and API integrations. A strong passion for technology and a commitment to continuous learning, including an interest in AI and its applications.
Bilingual: English and Spanish is a must.
Customer Focus: A data-informed approach to understanding customer needs and a demonstrated ability to build trusted, long-term relationships.
Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish is required. 
Collaborative Spirit: A team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment and works effectively with internal teams to drive customer success.



An ideal candidate also has:

Experience supporting global enterprise-level customers in a SaaS, IoT, or PaaS environment.
Proven experience leveraging AI tools and methodologies in daily workflows to drive efficiency, generate customer insights, and improve overall customer success.
Prior experience with Samsara, Salesforce, Zendesk, Jira, Gong, Gainsight, and Tableau.
Basic Python coding skills are an asset for providing enhanced technical solutions
 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

The Opportunity

MoveSmart Rentals is hiring an experienced Customer Retention Manager to manage existing property-owner relationships, prevent avoidable cancellations, recover dissatisfied clients, influence important decisions, and sell services that improve leasing results.

This is an individual-contributor position. You will manage a portfolio of existing clients—not a team of employees.

You will become the property owner’s main point of contact after they sign with MoveSmart. You will monitor each property’s leasing progress, identify problems, recommend solutions, overcome resistance, and keep the relationship moving through tenant move-in.

This is not a basic customer-service position. You will be expected to challenge unrealistic expectations, handle difficult conversations, protect the client relationship, and obtain clear decisions.

Direct real-estate experience is preferred but not required. Strong retention and consultative-sales professionals from other service industries are encouraged to apply.

The right person can listen to an upset client, establish the real issue, explain uncomfortable facts, and move the conversation toward a practical decision.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Acerca de WPP Media

WPP es la empresa de transformación creativa. Aprovechamos el poder de la creatividad para construir un futuro mejor para nuestra gente, el planeta, nuestros clientes y nuestras comunidades. Para obtener más información, visita wpp.com.

WPP Media es el colectivo global de medios de WPP. En un mundo donde los medios están en todas partes y en todo, reunimos las mejores plataformas, personas y socios para crear oportunidades ilimitadas de crecimiento. Para obtener más información, visita wppmedia.com

En WPP Media, creemos en el poder de nuestra cultura y de nuestra gente. Es lo que nos impulsa a ofrecer experiencias excepcionales tanto a nuestros clientes como entre nosotros. En este puesto, será fundamental adoptar los valores fundamentales compartidos por WPP y WPP Media:


Ser extraordinarios liderando colectivamente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora.
Crear un ambiente abierto equilibrando las experiencias de las personas y de los clientes mediante el fomento de la confianza.

Vida en WPP Media y Beneficios

Nuestra pasión por construir la nueva era de los medios cobra vida gracias a nuestro compromiso con Ser Extraordinarios, invirtiendo en nuestra gente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora. También Lideramos con Optimismo, creyendo firmemente e Impulsando el Crecimiento y Desarrollo de cada persona. Este compromiso permite a nuestro equipo en WPP Media aprovechar la amplia red global de WPP Media y WPP para perseguir sus pasiones, construir conexiones profesionales clave y aprender en la vanguardia del marketing y la publicidad.

Creamos un Entorno Abierto basado en la confianza y el respeto, donde cada persona sienta que pertenece y tenga oportunidades reales de crecer. Esta cultura inclusiva se fomenta a través de diversos grupos de recursos para empleados (ERG) y eventos frecuentes en la oficina para destacar los logros del equipo, compartir liderazgo de pensamiento y celebrar fechas especiales e hitos importantes. En WPP Media ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades y consideramos todas las postulaciones sin discriminación. description:
About Osmind

Osmind is a public benefit corporation advancing psychiatry through technology, services, and real-world evidence. Our software and services are used by 1,000+ interventional psychiatry practices across the U.S., the largest network of its kind. Our platform also supports life sciences companies developing and scaling access to cutting-edge treatments.

The Opportunity

RevOps at Osmind owns the revenue architecture across the full customer journey, from first marketing touch through closed-won, onboarding, expansion, and retention. That journey runs across four distinct go-to-market motions: scaled SMB sales, mid market sales-led with outbound, clinician customer engagement and upsell, and enterprise life sciences. Each has its own pipeline definitions, handoff logic, channels and conversion metrics. Keeping them connected and compounding is the core challenge. This role reports to the Revenue Operations Lead and works across all four.

You will work in a modern stack (HubSpot, Gong, Cargo, Unify, Metabase, Stripe, DocuSign, Arrows, Pylon, Chameleon) and be expected to extend it with AI-native workflows from day one. You will have the AI tools you need, whether that is Claude, Cursor, Cargo, Zapier or Lovable. A strong candidate would be able to sit in a working session, follow what the business is trying to do, and turn it into system work that holds up.

The role is built to grow. You will sit in the architecture, pricing and segmentation discussions rather than receive the output of them, and take on more of the design work as your understanding of the business deepens. The team is small, so you will have direct access to the people making those decisions.

What success looks like in the first 6 months: you own the systems work, and the teams that depend on it come to you directly. You have shipped at least one automation that took real manual work off someone's plate. You understand how the revenue engine fits together well enough to be forming a view on where it should go next.

What You'll Own

GTM systems

Build and maintain the CRM and the tooling around it: workflows, properties, pipelines, lists, dashboards, integrations, permissions. HubSpot is the center of gravity. You own the recurring hygiene that keeps the data trustworthy, and you close out the requests that come in from every function.

Revenue data and reporting

Keep the deal, product and revenue data accurate as the business changes shape. Build and maintain the dashboards leadership, sales and finance run on, and turn around ad hoc pulls fast. Support the reconciliation between what a customer is contracted for and what has actually been collected.

Deal process

Run the operational side of the deal desk: intake, routing, approvals, rate tables and contract templates. Sales gets a pricing decision back quickly and consistently, and you are part of why.

Campaign and outbound operations

Build and QA the target lists behind outbound and upsell campaigns. Keep account and contact data enriched and deduplicated, load audiences, and maintain the routing and attribution behind sourced pipeline.

Process design and automation

Get the process right before automating it. The first question is what the correct, durable process is and whether it still holds when volume triples. The second is how AI and automation make that process faster, cheaper and more accurate. Both matter, in that order. Start with the work you touch every week (enrichment, routing, hygiene, reporting) and build so the end user of that workflow or process has something that holds up rather than something that has to be rebuilt.

Documentation and enablement

Write down how each system actually works as you build in it, and answer the questions other teams bring. This is what keeps systems knowledge from sitting with one person.

Your First 90 Days


30 days: working knowledge of the GTM stack as it is configured here and the deal process end to end. Owning the inbound systems request queue.
60 days: running the recurring hygiene and reporting cadence independently. First automation shipped against something manual and weekly. Documentation started for the systems you have touched.
90 days: trusted across sales, finance and customer success to have their systems work handled. Bringing back what is breaking and where the next fix should go, unprompted.


What We're Looking For


2 to 4 years in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, finance operations or business operations
Zero to One mindset: Prior experience in scaling operations in fast paced teams, ideally at a Series A through C high growth startup
CRM experience (Salesforce, HubSpot). You have built workflows, custom properties, pipelines, lists and dashboards in it yourself, not just worked inside an existing build.
Range over specialization. You are curious about the whole revenue engine rather than one corner of it.
Iterative building approach: asking what the team is trying to accomplish before tooling, being able to pivot fast depending on outcomes and documenting as you go to ensure we build for scale.
Process first, then AI. You define the durable, scalable process before automating it, then use AI to make it faster and more accurate. You have shipped something real this way and have a point of view on where the tooling falls short.
Precision with data. You check your own work, trace a number back to its source, and know the difference between a number that is right and a number that looks right.
Clear written communication across sales, finance, customer success and support.


Bonus Points

Somos más que un lugar de trabajo: construimos y vivimos diariamente el Ecosistema Bien Estar Bien, basado en la relación armoniosa entre cada individuo, las relaciones a su alrededor y el entorno en el que está inmerso. Natura celebra y abraza la diversidad en todas sus formas y pluralidades.

description:
Description

We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager (PMM) to join the Amazon Payments Mexico marketing team. In this role, you will serve as the single-threaded owner of marketing execution for one or more payment products within the Amazon Mexico ecosystem. You will be responsible for converting marketing strategy into customer-facing outcomes through hands-on, week-by-week execution across onsite merchandising, promotions, performance reporting, and competitive intelligence.

This is a high-ownership, high-velocity role where you will manage the full execution lifecycle — from campaign creation and promotional configuration to post-campaign analysis — operating within Amazon's rigorous weekly business review cadence.

Key job responsibilities

Onsite Merchandising

Own all customer-facing placements on Amazon.com.mx including Maple campaigns (High Upsell Cards, Mobile View Cards, Priceblock banners, Wallet placements), DPIC content, Sparkle keyword campaigns, homepage hero banners, and landing pages

Manage creative briefing, review, scheduling coordination, and multi-channel QA across mobile, app, and desktop

Execute large-scale campaign rotations during High-Velocity Events (40+ onsite campaigns and 5–8 landing pages per event)

Configure targeting by card issuer and customer segment

Promotions & Discounts

Design promotional strategies for assigned payment products and navigate approval workflows with Finance and Legal

Configure promotions in relevant systems (PAWS, IBD coupon architecture, cashback configurations)

Coordinate with up to 14 issuing bank partners on offer structures, communication timing, and shared funding

Maintain a rolling pipeline of promotions planned quarters ahead and deliver post-promotion ROI reporting

Monitoring & Reporting

Produce weekly flash reports, WBR/MBR data pulls, and monthly deep-dive analyses

Maintain dashboards, detect anomalies, and deliver post-campaign performance reports and QBR inputs

Provide the feedback loop that determines campaign effectiveness, segment conversion, and budget efficiency

Competitive Intelligence

Conduct monthly structured competitive scans covering MercadoLibre, Liverpool, Coppel, major issuing banks, and emerging fintechs

Track feature launches, promotional mechanics, pricing changes, onsite merchandising tactics, and media spend shifts

Deliver intel summaries to the broader team and product partners

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Documentation

Write campaign briefs, BRDs, 1-pagers, and post-mortem narratives

Participate in weekly syncs with product managers, agency partners, legal/compliance reviews, and team ceremonies

Operate within Amazon's written communication culture and weekly business review cadence

About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
 Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
 Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
 Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
 Experience leading go-to-market for consumer software or hardware product launches


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience using any of SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis
 Experience with customer segmentation, profiling, and targeting


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak.
