Viva Talent connects US companies with exceptional Executive Assistants and creates meaningful, career-defining work for talented people across Latin America. We’re a globally distributed team of 200+ people across 15+ countries and 3 continents, on a mission to expand real opportunity for women in LATAM.




Why we’re opening this role




We’re opening this role to make candidate generation more consistent as Viva’s hiring needs grow. We need a builder-minded manager who can set up and drive a recruitment marketing strategy, using social media, paid campaigns, and other channels to attract qualified candidates and help us broaden our mission to empower more women in LATAM to access meaningful job opportunities.

Somos una empresa liderada por personas, empoderada por la tecnología, omnicanal, dedicada a ayudar a la gente a ahorrar dinero y vivir mejor.



En 2009, Walmart de México y Walmart Centroamérica iniciamos una nueva etapa de crecimiento y nos convertimos en un gran equipo. A partir de 2010, somos Walmart de México y Centroamérica, una de las cadenas comerciales más importantes de la región. Nuestra estrategia omnicanal está centrada en nuestros clientes y en mejorar su experiencia de compra.



Estamos presentes en 6 países: México, Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua y Costa Rica.



Contamos con 4,079 tiendas en la región, de las cuales 3,154 están en México y 925 en Centroamérica. Actualmente 6 millones de clientes compran en nuestras tiendas y clubes cada día en México y Centroamérica.



Continuamos ofreciendo a nuestros clientes los productos que necesitan a precios bajos, a través de nuestro portafolio con diversos formatos que tienen propuestas de valor únicas. Al mismo tiempo, aceleramos nuestra estrategia de digitalización. Todo ello, con el fin de servir mejor a todos nuestros clientes y socios en sus diferentes misiones de compra, en todos nuestros canales.





Descripción del empleo



En Walmart de México y Centroamérica buscamos un Analista Senior de Desarrollo de Negocios, que logre contrinuir al éxito de las campañas publicitarias de Walmart Connect mediante la planeación estratégica, seguimiento, análisis y optimización de iniciativas de Retail Media. Será responsable de diseñar estrategias de medios alineadas a los objetivos comerciales de los anunciantes, generar insights accionables basados en datos y proporcionar recomendaciones que maximicen el desempeño de las campañas, fortaleciendo la toma de decisiones y la experiencia de clientes y agencias.



Responsabilidades 



Desarrollar planes de medios alineados con los objetivos comerciales y de marketing de los anunciantes.
Diseñar estrategias de Retail Media considerando formatos onsite y offsite para maximizar resultados.
Analizar inventario, audiencias, formatos publicitarios y KPIs para generar recomendaciones estratégicas basadas en datos.
Monitorear el desempeño de campañas activas e identificar oportunidades de optimización.
Elaborar reportes ejecutivos, dashboards e insights que permitan evaluar resultados y generar recomendaciones para futuras campañas.
Presentar estrategias y resultados a clientes, agencias y stakeholders internos de manera clara y efectiva.
Colaborar estrechamente con los equipos de KAM, Client Success, Planning, AdOps y Performance para garantizar una correcta ejecución de las campañas.
Participar en la etapa final de las campañas comunicando resultados, aprendizajes y oportunidades de mejora.
Identificar tendencias de mercado, comportamiento de audiencias y mejores prácticas que contribuyan al crecimiento de Walmart Connect.


Requisitos



¿Qué buscamos?



2 a 4 años de experiencia en:
Retail Media.
Media Planning.
Marketing Digital.
Publicidad Digital.
eCommerce.
Agencias de medios o áreas afines.
Experiencia desarrollando estrategias de medios y recomendaciones para anunciantes.
Experiencia en análisis de campañas y generación de reportes de desempeño.
Experiencia trabajando de la mano con equipos comerciales, clientes o agencias.
Capacidad para transformar datos en insights y recomendaciones accionables.
Habilidad para realizar presentaciones ejecutivas y comunicar información compleja de manera clara.


Información adicional



En Walmart de México y Centroamérica estamos comprometidos con una cultura de pertenencia, por lo que buscamos incorporar el mejor talento basándonos en competencias, habilidades y potencial; no discriminamos por ningún motivo, incluyendo género, edad, origen étnico, apariencia física, estado civil, condiciones de salud por VIH o cualquier enfermedad, situación socioeconómica, discapacidad, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género por ello durante el proceso de atracción y selección no solicitaremos información personal, fotografías o análisis clínicos de ningún tipo. Los datos personales del candidato o candidata no son relevantes durante el proceso de entrevista ni para la selección final. En Walmart de México y Centroamérica nos comprometemos con nuestros/as asociados/as para que encuentren día a día en el trabajo un ambiente de respeto, libre de discriminación y acoso sexual.

description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Acerca de WPP Media

WPP es la empresa de transformación creativa. Aprovechamos el poder de la creatividad para construir un futuro mejor para nuestra gente, el planeta, nuestros clientes y nuestras comunidades. Para obtener más información, visita wpp.com.

WPP Media es el colectivo global de medios de WPP. En un mundo donde los medios están en todas partes y en todo, reunimos las mejores plataformas, personas y socios para crear oportunidades ilimitadas de crecimiento. Para obtener más información, visita wppmedia.com

En WPP Media, creemos en el poder de nuestra cultura y de nuestra gente. Es lo que nos impulsa a ofrecer experiencias excepcionales tanto a nuestros clientes como entre nosotros. En este puesto, será fundamental adoptar los valores fundamentales compartidos por WPP y WPP Media:


Ser extraordinarios liderando colectivamente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora.
Crear un ambiente abierto equilibrando las experiencias de las personas y de los clientes mediante el fomento de la confianza.
Liderar con optimismo promoviendo el crecimiento y el desarrollo para movilizar a la empresa.


Responsabilidades


Control operativo y trazabilidad end-to-end: Centralizar y dar seguimiento riguroso al ciclo completo de operación de medios (seguimiento de la planeación, compra, implementación, reporting y conciliación) para las 6 marcas del portafolio.
Gestión de planes de trabajo y presupuestos: Supervisar la consistencia de la información, calendarios, fechas compromiso, presupuestos y entregables clave; identificar desviaciones y riesgos de manera oportuna.
Liderazgo de reporteo y analítica: Guiar al equipo operativo en el armado, estandarización, control de calidad y automatización de reportes periódicos con hallazgos accionables.
Coordinación de equipos e interacciones: Coordinar a los equipos involucrados para asegurar el cumplimiento de procesos, servir de enlace operativo con publishers / exclusivas de medios y liberar capacidad de los managers para que se enfoquen en la estrategia y crecimiento.
Visibilidad y estatus de marca: Dar visibilidad clara y estructurada sobre el estatus operativo transversal del portafolio al Media Lead / Director de Medios.


Habilidades y Experiencia


Licenciatura en Publicidad, Mercadotecnia, Comunicación, Administración de Empresas o carreras afines.
Intermedio - Redacción fluida y presentación de informes ejecutivos en inglés.
3 a 5 años de experiencia general en la cadena operativa de medios (planeación, compra, implementación, reporting y conciliación), con al menos 1 o 2 años supervisando procesos o coordinando equipos tácticos.


Herramientas


Digital Ads & Trafficking: Display & Video 360 (DV360), Google Ads MCC, Meta Business Manager, TikTok Ads Manager.
Analytics & Control: Google Analytics 4 (GA4), dashboards de seguimiento y gestión de datos (Looker Studio, Power BI).
Retail Media & Programmatic: Plataformas programáticas y Retail Media Networks (ej. Mercado Libre Ads, Walmart Connect).


Vida en WPP Media y Beneficios

Nuestra pasión por construir la nueva era de los medios cobra vida gracias a nuestro compromiso con Ser Extraordinarios, invirtiendo en nuestra gente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora. También Lideramos con Optimismo, creyendo firmemente e Impulsando el Crecimiento y Desarrollo de cada persona. Este compromiso permite a nuestro equipo en WPP Media aprovechar la amplia red global de WPP Media y WPP para perseguir sus pasiones, construir conexiones profesionales clave y aprender en la vanguardia del marketing y la publicidad.

Creamos un Entorno Abierto basado en la confianza y el respeto, donde cada persona sienta que pertenece y tenga oportunidades reales de crecer. Esta cultura inclusiva se fomenta a través de diversos grupos de recursos para empleados (ERG) y eventos frecuentes en la oficina para destacar los logros del equipo, compartir liderazgo de pensamiento y celebrar fechas especiales e hitos importantes. Nuestro paquete integral de beneficios refleja este compromiso e incluye seguro médico, de visión y dental, planes grupales de retiro, un generoso programa de tiempo libre pagado, descuentos preferenciales con aliados y días dedicados al bienestar y la salud mental de nuestro equipo.

En WPP Media ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades y consideramos todas las postulaciones sin discriminación. Creemos que el mejor trabajo surge cuando estamos juntos, potenciando la creatividad, la colaboración y la conexión en un entorno abierto y colaborativo. Por eso, hemos adoptado un modelo de trabajo híbrido, asistiendo a la oficina alrededor de tres días a la semana. Si requieres alguna adaptación o flexibilidad, te invitamos a conversarlo con el equipo de selección durante el proceso de entrevista. Ten en cuenta que, si bien nuestra filosofía es la misma en todo WPP, los beneficios específicos pueden variar según la oficina o el país.

Por favor, consulta nuestro Aviso de Privacidad (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) para obtener más información sobre cómo procesamos la información que nos proporcionas.

Agradecemos a todas las personas que se postulen a esta vacante; sin embargo, solo contactaremos a los candidatos seleccionados para una entrevista.

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

description:
About the Role:

We’re looking for an Affiliate Account Manager to recruit, grow, and manage the publishers and affiliates that drive our Home Services traffic (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, solar, windows, water damage, and similar). You’ll be the main point of contact for our affiliate partners, responsible for scaling high-quality volume, negotiating payouts, and keeping partners compliant and profitable. You’ll work closely with our buyer-side and quality teams so that the traffic we bring in converts and stays within buyer requirements.




Key Responsibilities:

Recruit and onboard new affiliates, publishers, and media buyers in the Home Services space across channels such as paid search, native, social, SEO, and display
Manage a portfolio of existing affiliates: day-to-day communication, performance reviews, and growth planning
Negotiate payouts, caps, and terms, balancing publisher profitability with our margins
Match affiliates to the right campaigns and offers based on their traffic type, geography, and past performance
Monitor daily performance (volume, conversion, quality, and revenue) and act quickly on drops, spikes, and anomalies
Work with QA and compliance to address low-quality or non-compliant traffic, give publishers clear feedback, and make decisions on pausing, capping, or removing sources
Make sure affiliates follow buyer requirements, approved creative, disclosures, and applicable regulations (TCPA, call recording consent, FTC advertising rules)
Provide affiliates with campaign briefs, creative guidelines, and optimization recommendations
Track and report on KPIs: active affiliates, revenue per affiliate, margin, conversion rates, and retention
Attend industry events and maintain relationships across the affiliate and lead generation community
Keep affiliate payment, invoicing, and reconciliation running smoothly with finance

Requirements:

2+ years of affiliate management experience in lead generation or performance marketing, ideally in Home Services
Established relationships with affiliates, publishers, or media buyers, or a clear track record of recruiting new ones
Strong understanding of lead gen and pay-per-call economics (payout, margin, EPC/RPC, conversion rate)
Experience with an affiliate or call tracking platform (Ringba, Everflow, CAKE, HasOffers, Voluum, or similar)
Strong negotiation and relationship management skills
Analytical mindset with comfort in spreadsheets and performance reporting
Excellent written and verbal communication
Self-motivated and able to work Pacific Time business hours

Nice to Have:

Experience across multiple verticals (e.g., Solar, Legal, Insurance, Medicare)
Familiarity with traffic fraud detection and compliance practices
Experience running or buying media yourself
Prior experience on both the affiliate and buyer side of the business

description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Senior Associate Digital IO, GOC

Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Associate Digital IO who will:


Campaign Execution: Lead the setup, execution, and documentation of direct IO media campaigns across various partners, particularly any high-value or complex campaigns. Ensure all aspects of campaign are delivered according to terms outlined in the client approved media plan and IOs 
Campaign Optimization and Reporting: Collaborate with Managers and Associates and Managers in monitoring campaign performance metrics, including impressions, clicks, spend, and any campaign specific KPIs. Analyze campaign performance reporting, and utilize data driven insights to guide optimization recommendations to enhance campaign effectiveness and achieve client goals. 
Budget Oversight: Manage campaign budgets to ensure optimal performance and efficient spend. Monitor and QA monthly budget reconciliation completed by Associates and assist where necessary. 
Team Leadership: Mentor and provide guidance to Associates and team members involved in Digital IO campaigns. Foster a collaborative environment and support professional development within the team. 
Process Improvement: Identify and implement process improvements to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of Digital Io campaign management, 


Skills And Experience

If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:


Have a bachelor's degree. 
Your level of English is advanced (B2-C2) (Indispensable for the position). 
1+ years of experience implementing campaigns on digital platforms such as DV360, the Trade Desk, or Campaign Manager 360. 
Previous experience with billing platfors such as Prisma, Coupa, Advertmind, MMS, Adspend or others. 


Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

description:
Why Join Subway?

At Subway, we are not standing still. We are building. This is a business focused on what matters most: growing franchisee profitability, strengthening our brand and creating long-term value. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to make a real impact. You will not just do the work. You will shape it.

We move fast. We think like owners. We make decisions that matter. We hold ourselves to a high standard because what we do directly impacts thousands of franchisees around the world. If you bring energy, accountability and a bias for action, you will fit right in. We take the work seriously, but we also know the best results come from teams that support each other, celebrate wins and show up ready to build something better every day. This is your chance to be part of what's next.

About The Role

The Senior Brand Manager is responsible for executing Subway Mexico's brand strategy on a day-to-day basis, translating the guidelines set by the Senior Brand Director into concrete campaigns, activations, and launches. They lead the creative and media development of ATL, BTL, Digital, and Influencer campaigns, coordinate the execution of the Innovation Pipeline, and monitor the performance of traffic, sales, and the brand budget. They act as the operational point of contact with agencies, vendors, and internal teams to ensure the brand is experienced consistently across all consumer touchpoints.

Responsibilities Include But Not Limited To


Brief, creation, and execution of ATL, BTL, Digital, and Influencer campaigns, including the building and management of media plans.
End-to-end management of marketing projects and coordination with Operations/Franchise for their execution at the restaurant level.
Development and execution of 360 activation plans, including image and packaging development
Co-creation and execution of the Innovation Pipeline (product launches).
Traffic and sales forecasting; budget building and control, and updating of brand performance dashboards.


Core Competencies


Strategic thinking and the ability to translate strategy into tactical execution.
Negotiation skills with agencies and vendors.
Project management and the ability to handle multiple initiatives simultaneously.
Data analysis and brand performance metrics (traffic, sales, media ROI).
Creative judgment and brand sensibility.
Communication skills and collaborative work with multidisciplinary teams.
Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; intermediate-to-advanced English level.
Ability to work under pressure and with multiple stakeholders.


What do we Offer?

Mobility Allowance
Tuition Reimbursement
Company Holidays

description:
Brand Manager

Ready to turn consumer insights into meaningful growth? Want to shape brands, accelerate innovation and make a difference in people’s everyday lives? Bring your business mindset and ideas to Essity and help us innovate for good.

About The Role

As Brand Manager, you will take ownership of key brands within our feminine care portfolio, helping drive their performance and long-term growth. This is an opportunity to go beyond traditional brand communications and manage the brand as a business, connecting consumer and market insights with opportunities to increase penetration, trial, value and profitability.

You will combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, helping advance an active innovation pipeline while working closely with local and global partners across functions such as Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, Trade Marketing and Insights. You will have the opportunity to influence decisions, remove barriers and turn ambitious ideas into consumer-focused initiatives with measurable business impact.

What You Will Do


Brand & Business Ownership: Lead your assigned brands with accountability for business performance, brand building, profitable growth, assortment and pricing.
Brand Planning: Develop and activate annual brand plans, define activation touchpoints and manage marketing investment in line with business priorities and global guidance.
Consumer & Market Insights: Translate consumer, customer and market information into clear strategies and actions that create growth opportunities.
Innovation: Advance product and brand innovation from idea and feasibility through implementation, supporting strong business cases and successful market activation.
Campaign Execution: Lead local brand and innovation activations, monitor results and implement corrective actions to improve performance.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Mobilize local and global stakeholders across commercial and support functions to solve challenges and deliver initiatives effectively.
Market Execution: Stay close to consumers and the marketplace, supporting field activities and turning market learning into practical improvements.


Who You Are


You bring relevant professional experience in brand, category or business management, with evidence of owning business outcomes and translating strategy into execution.
You have experience using consumer and market insights to identify opportunities, make decisions and build actionable strategies.
You can manage innovation and complex projects through multiple stages while balancing competing priorities and maintaining attention to detail.
You combine strategic and analytical thinking with autonomy, curiosity, action orientation and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
You are comfortable collaborating with global teams and communicating complex information clearly to different stakeholders.


What We Can Offer You

Our purpose, Breaking Barriers to Well-Being, provides meaning to everything we do. Join us to improve well-being for people and drive positive change for society and the environment. At Essity, you'll feel valued, empowered to grow, and challenged to achieve business results in a collaborative and open atmosphere. Innovate for Good | Excel Together | Be You with Us

Multimodal Execution: Lead high-impact training delivery across live classroom sessions, immersive bootcamps, virtual workshops, and self-paced digital modules via enterprise Learning Management Systems (LMS).

Needs Assessment & Strategic Alignment:
Capability Gap Analysis: Proactively identify technical skill gaps through data analytics, quality audits, stakeholder interviews with operations leaders, and incoming campaign requirements.
Agile Curriculum Adaptation: Rapidly adjust training roadmaps to align with fast-moving product launches, platform migrations, and shifts in client specifications.

Ecosystem Partnerships: Cultivate strategic relationships with operations managers, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and client stakeholders to stay ahead of industry trends and emerging marketing tech.
Knowledge Management: Own end-to-end product knowledge management for the vertical, serving as the central hub for technical enablement updates.
Experience: Minimum 4–6 years of progressive experience in Learning & Development, Technical Training, or MarTech Operations within a fast-paced corporate, agency, or tech environment.
MarTech & Marketing Operations Acumen: Deep familiarity with marketing workflows, digital campaigns, multi-channel customer journeys, and creative production cycles.
Technical Proficiency: Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for email template troubleshooting, landing page configuration, and navigating digital marketing platforms.
Facilitation & Communication: Exceptional presentation, workshop facilitation, and cross-functional communication skills in both English and Spanish.
Bilingual Proficiency: Full professional proficiency in English and Spanish (written and spoken).
Platform Expertise: 3+ years of hands-on experience configuring, managing, or training on enterprise marketing automation and CRM tools (e.g., Marketo, Eloqua, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot).
Digital Advertising Stack & Paid Media: Comprehensive understanding of Paid Media campaign strategies, execution, tracking, and the Google Marketing Platform / Google Ads ecosystem.

Experience with designing and interpreting Alpha/Beta testing frameworks (A/B testing, multivariate testing for campaigns).

ABM Manager at BairesDev




In this role, you'll be the closest partner our commercial teams have inside Growth Marketing, working daily with US-based sales and account leaders. - Test new channels and plays beyond the core four, such as event follow-up, video, or retargeting, and scale the ones that move pipeline.

- 2+ years working with US-based commercial teams or marketing to US B2B buyers.

- Hands-on experience executing multi-channel campaigns across at least three of: email sequences, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail/gifting, with email sequences and LinkedIn required.

- Daily, hands-on use of generative AI or LLM tools (Claude preferred; ChatGPT or Gemini accepted) inside automations, not only for writing copy.

- Native or bilingual proficiency in English.

- Industrial or process engineering background, or documented process-mapping work (BPMN, swimlanes in Lucidchart/Miro) used to design sales or marketing workflows.

- Experience in B2B tech services, IT staffing, or nearshore/outsourcing companies.

- Background running campaigns aimed at existing accounts, such as expansion, cross-sell, or renewal plays with account managers.

- Familiarity with intent data or ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase, ZoomInfo, Bombora, Common Room).

- Scripting experience for automations (Python, JavaScript, or SQL; APIs and webhooks).

title: Agency Growth Manager (Premium) - TikTok LIVE
description:
Responsibilities
The livestream industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become the next growth driver for TikTok global business. It also brings great joy to users globally and it creates a new channel for our creators to show themselves.

Responsibilities
Creators are at the center of our operations. Through professional agencies and MCNs in the content business, especially those that specialize in livestreaming, we are building scale and democratization of the livestreaming business. In this role of Agency Growth Manager, you will carry out two main sets of responsibilities that will drive business growth in a sustainable way:

Agency Management
  - Design TikTok LIVE LATAM's agency growth strategy for recruiting, retaining, and helping agencies scale up in their business on the platform. 
  - Design agency's benefit system and growth program to incentivize better performance and sustainable revenue growth.
  - Conduct day-to-day management directly with agency managers and their creators to materialize and iterate the strategic programs to deliver business results. Provide additional support to agencies and their creators for the needs related to content and platform guidelines. 
  - Build LIVE showcases with successful agencies and increase the positive impact of working with the platform in the agency community.
  - Collaborate with internal and cross-functional teams to carry out in-app and out-of-app campaigns and drive participation and results from agency creators.
  - Monitor results metrics for agency growth and performance, and conduct regular analysis to generate operational insights for improvement.

Agency Education and Capacity Building
  - Design LIVE's agency empowerment program with practical tips and know-how about how to scale up agency's operation and revenue potential with a focus on agency professionalization.
  - Facilitate business and industry knowledge transfer from top agencies to emerging agencies, learn from global best practices and localize the expertise to educate local agencies on how to scale.
  - Share the platform know-how on content tips and trends to agencies to improve their creators' LIVE performance and revenue generation.
  - Conduct training to agencies for the above mentioned topics, leveraging different tools and social platforms.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or above.
- More than 2 years of working experience relates to creator management, especially managing influencer agencies and/or MCNs.
- Candidates who are sensitive to cultural trends, possess a good understanding of the content industry, creator economy and business acumen on newly emerged industries are preferred. 
- Professional, patient, and skillful communication with talents/influencers. 
- Result-oriented and data-driven operation.
- Proficient in both verbal and written English since business communication with global teams are in English.

Preferred Qualifications
- Candidates who are used to work with, or have connections with modeling, content, media, TV, celebrities, and livestreaming platforms.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws.
